$comment: Security-scan ledger — the SSOT for adversarial ('Destructive agent') review state, keyed by code.json module key. code.json is GENERATED from the master plan and must never be hand-edited (GR#3, GR#6), so scan stamps live HERE and tools/plan/generate.js merges them into each module's `securityScan` field at generation time. That way `code.json` shows the stamp, as required, without the stamp being destroyed by the next regeneration. Written by Destructive agents; read by the lead and /health-check.
scanVersionMeaning: v1 = manual adversarial review by a Destructive agent against the v1 checklist: input validation and trust boundaries, integer/slice bounds and conversion safety, type confusion, encapsulation and exported-surface leakage, concurrency safety, resource exhaustion, error-path information disclosure, insecure-call-ability (can a caller use this API wrongly and get an unsafe result?). Bumping this version invalidates every stamp below and requires a fresh sweep.
